sections.section_title: XSPI1 and XSPI2 drive a single external memory
sections.text_helper: Section 29.5.7 "XSPI1 and XSPI2 drive a single external memory" in chapter 29 (XSPI I/O manager (XSPIM)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1366.
sections.section_content:
This is similar to XSPIs multiplexed mode to Port 1, but in this case only one external
memory is present. Both CSSEL controls must target the same NCS (NCS1 in Figure224).
[Figure 224. XSPI1 and XSPI2 drive a single external memory (octal mode)]
Note: This use case is valid even when Port 2 is used instead of Port 1, and also possible with
XSPI1 and XSPI2 interfacing a 16-bit memory (connecting XSPIM_P1_DQS1 to the
memory).
